title: Pinching rigidity of surfaces with parallel mean curvature vector in spheres
summary: Inspired by the Simon conjecture for minimal surfaces in spheres, we study closed surfaces with parallel mean curvature vector and positive Gaussian curvature immersed in unit spheres. Let $h$ be the second fundamental form, let $\mathbf{H}$ be the mean curvature vector field, and set $\tilde h=h-\mathbf{H}g$ and $\tilde S=|\tilde h|^2=|h|^2-2H^2$, where $H=|\mathbf{H}|$ and $g$ is the induced Riemannian metric on the surface $M$. We establish three Simons-type integral identities for $\tilde S$, which extend the first, second and third gap identities in the minimal case. As applications, we…
